# Collision Lab numerical modules

Selected original modules from Collision Lab 0.7.0 are reused verbatim. On November 3, 2026, original copyright owner Steven Reid confirmed ownership of all original Collision Lab code and authorized reuse under World Explorer3D's source-available license. This authorization covers original application code; independently licensed software, geometry and data retain their own terms. World Explorer's [project license](../../../LICENSE) governs this authorized reuse. The source project's historical GPL 3 text is retained in [COPYING-GPL-HISTORY.txt](COPYING-GPL-HISTORY.txt); it is not a new license for World Explorer or for third-party assets.

Source filenames, version and exact digests are recorded in [source-manifest.json](source-manifest.json). These are the already qualified original models and recorded-data calculations, with no second Three.js, original renderer/orbit controls, scientific vendor binaries or user notebook. The browser adapter supplies bounded requests and World Explorer's lifecycle. Recorded data and event-display geometry have their own [data credits](../../assets/data/cms/ATTRIBUTION.md) and [geometry credits](../../assets/models/cms/ATTRIBUTION.md).
